about_us.who_are_we_text: Havenly is a modern accommodation booking platform created by two passionate developers, Bence József Guvat and Máté János Herczeg, with the goal of making accommodation search and rental simpler, more transparent, and more enjoyable for all users.
about_us.havenly_mission_text: Our goal is to create a user-friendly website where booking and renting accommodations are fast, secure, and convenient. Havenly is not only a booking system but also a community platform that connects travelers and hosts while helping them discover the hidden gems and attractions of different cities.

havenly_offer.first_offer: book accommodations or upload and rent out their own property after registration,
havenly_offer.second_offer: upload detailed descriptions, photos, and videos of accommodations,
havenly_offer.third_offer: add local attractions and experiences to cities,
havenly_offer.fourth_offer: help other users make decisions by leaving reviews,
havenly_offer.fifth_offer: manage their account and payment data securely,
havenly_offer.sixth_offer: easily modify or delete their accommodations and bookings.

about_us.booking_and_security_text: The website automatically manages bookings, preventing date conflicts and double bookings. Each booking instantly notifies the host, and both parties have the option to cancel under predefined conditions.
about_us.contact_and_communication_text: Havenly features an internal messaging system that enables quick and easy communication between hosts and guests. Contact via email and phone is also supported, as registration requires valid contact details.
about_us.multilingualism_and_future_text: The website will be available in multiple languages to provide an accessible and convenient solution for as many users as possible. Our long-term vision is for Havenly to become a reliable, constantly evolving platform that creates real value for both travelers and hosts.

data_protection.data_protection_text_first: Havenly is committed to protecting users’ personal data. This Privacy Policy aims to transparently and clearly explain what data we collect, how we process it, and what rights users have regarding their personal information.
data_protection.data_protection_text_second: Havenly is an online accommodation booking and sharing platform where users can book accommodations, upload their own properties, and share local attractions and experiences with others.

intro.description_1: Havenly (hereinafter: “Provider”, “Platform”, “We”) is an online accommodation booking and sharing web application that allows users to book accommodations, upload their own properties, and share local attractions and experiences.
intro.description_2: By using the Platform, the user (“User”, “You”) accepts these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.

service_nature.intro: Havenly is a web application created as part of a final exam project that provides the following features:
service_nature.education_note: The Platform’s operation is based on educational development, but it follows the logic of real-world service terms.

registration_account.requirements_intro: Registration is required to use the Platform. The User must:

requirements.valid_contact: use a valid email address and phone number

registration_account.responsibility: The User is responsible for the security of their account, especially for keeping their password confidential. The Provider is not liable for unauthorized account use.

rules.legal_use: not use the Platform for illegal purposes
rules.truthful_content: not upload false, misleading, or offensive content
rules.copyright: not post copyrighted content without permission
rules.system_integrity: not attempt to disrupt system operations

user_obligations.sanctions: The Provider reserves the right to suspend or delete accounts that violate the rules.

property_responsibility.host_intro: The User uploading a property (“Host”) is responsible for ensuring that:

host_duties.legal_media: all uploaded images and videos are lawfully usable,
host_duties.availability: the property is actually available for rent,
host_duties.timely_response: booking requests are responded to in a timely manner.

property_responsibility.disclaimer: The Provider is not responsible for the quality or condition of accommodations or disputes between Hosts and Guests.

booking_process.select: The User selects accommodation and date.
booking_process.confirmation: The booking is created, and the Host is notified.

cancellation_rules.guest_rules: The Guest can cancel the booking according to the Host’s terms.
cancellation_rules.host_rights: The Host may reject or cancel a booking if the time is unsuitable.

bookings_cancellations.refunds: Refunds are determined according to the Host’s rules.

payments.payment_info: The Platform allows users to set up payment methods. Bank card data are not processed by Havenly but by an external payment provider.
payments.no_liability_intro: The Provider is not liable for:

no_liability.incorrect_data: damages resulting from incorrect data entry.

messaging.rules: The Platform provides a messaging system between Host and Guest. The User agrees not to send harassing, offensive, or illegal messages.
messaging.monitoring: The Provider reserves the right to review communications in cases of suspected abuse.

liability_limitation.no_liability_intro: The Provider is not liable for:

no_liability.downtime: any errors or downtime of the Platform,
no_liability.property_quality: the quality or condition of accommodations,

liability_limitation.own_risk: Use of the Platform is at the User’s own risk.

service_modification.modification_right: The Provider reserves the right to modify features, expand or limit services, and update these Terms of Use.
service_modification.notification: Users will be notified of changes through the website.

contact.contact_text: In case of questions or issues, users can contact us through the provided contact details.
